svg.text: Base chassis power distribution, drive control and odometry feedback.
Motor leads: Red → MxA, Black → MxB, identical on all four. Left and right direction is handled in firmware by a per-motor sign table.
ESP32 GND · boost GND · buck GND · both MDD20A logic GND · shifter LV−/HV− · all 4 encoder Black — every one of these on a single rail.
Missing any one of these connections produces phantom motor behaviour. Pi ground reaches ESP32 ground through the USB cable.
